status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: CacheAbstractTest.TestDestroy causes this, because ProcessorDestroyCache is not void by mistake, so garbage data gets into unmanagedTarget, and causes crash when Release is called.
